spec_match.rationale: Three of four policies use the stale config shape attributes:{href:['a']} which the shipped Sanitizer rejects (TypeError: Failed to read the 'attributes' property); the catch silently falls back to the DEFAULT sanitizer, so comment/rich/strict all render identical default output.

interactive.rationale: Preset cards (click), textarea and Apply update rendered and serialized output, but three of four policies have no real effect.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a custom allow-list Sanitizer per use case; on a supporting browser the user sees the default sanitizer under every policy label except plain-text.

edge_cases.rationale: The constructor error branch is swallowed into a fake 'policy' result; 'Plain text only' (elements:[]) drops all element content ('Bold and italic text.' → ' and text.') yet the copy claims it is 'identical to textContent' — replaceWithChildrenElements is never shown.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/5814067399491584 and MDN; no spec link.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 7/7 PASS on CfT 153, but it only constructs Sanitizer({elements:['p']}) and never checks the attributes shape or that a custom config changes output — so it did not catch this page's fake fallback.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 driven by Node Playwright (chromium.launch) against a local server on :3111 — NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP-verified evidence; no accessibility-tree dump was taken. Measured: new Sanitizer(comment|strict config) → TypeError; Sanitizer({elements:[]}) and the spec shape {elements:[{name:'a',attributes:['href']},'b']} → ok. Serialized output identical for comment, rich and strict. The textarea contains a literal '<\/script>' so the sample <script> never closes and swallows the 'Click bait' paragraph. Enter on a focused preset card does nothing. 0 console errors; 0px overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: The constructor TypeError is caught and discarded, so the core failure never reaches telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Variables and readable contrast in screenshots.

accessibility.rationale: Preset cards are divs with tabindex=0 but no role and no key handler — Enter/Space cannot select a policy (verified); no selected state; output not announced.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow both classes; Apply button under 44px on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Rewrite policy configs to the shipped SanitizerConfig shape and surface constructor errors
openQuestions.detail: Repro: click 'Comment box', 'Rich text' and 'Strict' → serialized output identical (default sanitizer). Use elements:[{name:'a',attributes:['href']},'b','i',…] or elements + global attributes:['href'], and display any TypeError instead of falling back to setHTML(html). This is the 'fake fallback' anti-regression case.

openQuestions.title: Make preset cards real buttons with selected state
openQuestions.detail: Repro: Tab to 'Comment box', press Enter → active policy unchanged. Use <button aria-pressed> (or a radio group) so keyboard users can switch policy.

openQuestions.title: Fix the plain-text policy claim and the '<\/script>' sample
openQuestions.detail: elements:[] removes elements with their content; to keep text use replaceWithChildrenElements or show the difference explicitly. The textarea's literal <\/script> leaves the sample script unterminated.

openQuestions.title: Show sanitizer.get() normalisation and allow/remove mutators
openQuestions.detail: The spec exposes get(), allowElement/removeElement/replaceElementWithChildren/allowAttribute/removeAttribute/setComments/setDataAttributes/removeUnsafe; an inspector that edits a Sanitizer and prints get() covers the configuration-tooling angle.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use setHTML()/Document.parseHTML() with a Sanitizer config of the current shape (elements, attributes, replaceWithChildrenElements); elements not in `elements` are removed with their content; unsafe elements cannot be re-allowed via setHTML.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — uses a superseded attributes-dict shape; spec-shape guidance (elements/attributes arrays, replaceWithChildrenElements) would fix it.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Selection groups should be native <button>s exposing state (aria-pressed / radio semantics) so keyboard Enter/Space activates and the selected option is announced.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — div cards, no keyboard activation, no pressed state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/grid layouts that collapse to one column at narrow widths (minmax(0,1fr), container/media queries) so no fixed-column track forces horizontal overflow.

summary: The most serious sanitizer defect: three of the four 'custom' policies throw in the shipped Sanitizer constructor and are silently replaced by the default sanitizer, so the page presents default output as the comment/rich/strict policies. Preset cards are also keyboard-inaccessible.
